content: Local DB choice for Flutter offline caching: Hive = pure-Dart key-value store, lowest boilerplate, best for simple/flat cached blobs, weak on relations/queries. Isar = NoSQL doc store, fast indexed/filtered queries, good for a single collection of similar cached objects. Drift = SQL/SQLite with type-safe generated queries, best fit when data is relational (foreign keys, join tables, ordering) and complex queries needed. Community consensus: use Drift when caching relational domain data with joins/ordering; Hive/Isar better for flatter key-value caches.
